states.name: InitialLoad
states.description: Scene loaded with VirtualCity and 5 water bottles, initial water distribution set, no bottle selected

states.name: BottleSelected
states.description: User has clicked a bottle, it is highlighted with emissive glow, transfer slider panel is visible
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.selectedBottleId === 'string' && window.__3D_STATE__.selectedBottleId !== '' && window.__3D_STATE__.transferInProgress === false

states.name: WaterTransferring
states.description: Water is animating from source bottle to target bottle, fill cylinders scaling, transfer in progress

states.name: ConservationVerified
states.description: After transfer, total water budget remains exactly 100 units across all bottles
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.transferInProgress === false && window.__3D_STATE__.totalWaterBudget === 100 && Math.abs((window.__3D_STATE__.bottleAWater + window.__3D_STATE__.bottleBWater + window.__3D_STATE__.bottleCWater + window.__3D_STATE__.bottleDWater + window.__3D_STATE__.bottleEWater) - 100) < 0.01

states.name: ThresholdsSatisfied
states.description: All five districts meet or exceed their minimum water thresholds
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleAWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtAThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleBWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtBThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleCWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtCThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleDWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtDThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleEWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtEThreshold

states.name: StableEquilibrium
states.description: System stable with no transfers for extended period, all constraints satisfied

action.code: document.querySelector('canvas').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles: true, clientX: window.innerWidth/2, clientY: window.innerHeight/2}))

postconditions: A bottle is selected and highlighted
selectedBottleId is set to a valid district
Water conservation law holds: sum equals 100

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles: true, clientX: rect.left + rect.width*0.3, clientY: rect.top + rect.height*0.4}));

postconditions: Different bottle selected for next transfer

action.code: for(let i=0; i<3; i++){const slider = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); if(slider){slider.value = 5; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); setTimeout(()=>document.querySelector('button')?.click(), 100 + i*600);}}

postconditions: Multiple transfers executed to balance distribution

checks.expr: window.__3D_STATE__.bottleBWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtBThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleCWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtCThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleDWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtDThreshold && window.__3D_STATE__.bottleEWater >= window.__3D_STATE__.districtEThreshold
